notes.title: Brody the Brawler, combining units and a buff/debuff overhaul!
notes.content:
I'm very exciting for this update! I think this really starts to put different units into different tiers. We now have two heroes and a third on the way! Well lets get to it

Brody the Brawler
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37374329/7db586efd8a52800e00911b24b7da9af85461df3.png
Brody is a melee hero! Brody comes with four different abilities.

Ground smash
Brody powers up his mace and slams it into an opposing unit! That unit is then stunned and takes massive damage!

Battle Shout
Brody yells fiercely increasing instantly recovering HP and then recovering HP over the next few turns. He also increases his AP and DP for the duration of this buff.

Sweeping Strike
Brody pull his mace back and damages enemies in an arch. This ability will damage the target tile along with anyone standing next to the target, including your own units! Be careful! Another unique feature about this attack is that it only has a cool down of one turn!

Intense Focus
Brody takes a moment to focus, regaining all of his AP this turn. This is good for getting out of or into situations!

This combination of skills allows Brody to get in and out of combat quickly and all gives him a lot of durability!

Combining Units
I'm very excited about this concept. It should bridge the gap between the tier 1 units and the heroes by quite a bit. When playing the game before, you could obviously tell that the heroes were just so much stronger than the tier 1 units that it was almost a race to the hero tech. Well with this feature, you can take two tier one units and combine them into a tier 2 unit. i.e take two tier 1 warrior and combine them into a tier 2 warrior. A tier two warrior will essentially be as strong as two tier 1 units but only take up one space.

Buffs & Debuffs
Buffs and debuffs have been in the game for awhile but there wasn't a visual representation for them in the game. For this update, we added a swirling debuff spinner above every character in the game. If you have a buff.. or a debuff.. it'll show up there and be something you can see at a glance.

That's it!
Until next time
-Jesse

notes.title: Streaks and beautiful water
notes.content:
I'm excited to be moving the game into version .5. This major update will introduce the concepts of streaks. 

What are streaks?
Streaks are how many times in a row you've hit a perfect skill check. By doing this your attack will do additional damage. This will allow players to control the tide of battle by simply performing well. This effect starts at 10% more base damage per perfect skill check all the way up to 50% more damage. This effect will stay in play until you mess up.

I thought the game skill ceiling was a little too low but adding streaks to the game will push the ceiling much higher! A lot of times when you're fighting another players unit with one of your own, they will be low health so you know you won't have to hit a perfect skill check to kill them. But now you also have to make the decision to mess up your streak; winning the battle but losing the war.

Ocean Shader
I updated the ocean shader to a more pleasant look and feel. The last one seemed to spaazy for me and was a plane that was just stretched. Now I've redone this effect to lay planes down next to each other in a grid and you can see for yourself, it looks a lot better.

Until next time!
~Jesse

notes.title: We have Heroes!
notes.content:
Claire, the Fire Mage
We've released our first hero, Claire. Claire is now available in the Hero Monument. She is much more powerful than any other unit in the game. She comes with four abilities to wreck your opponent.

 Fireblast - this shoots two fireballs at a single target dealing damage and setting them on fire.
 Fire Eruption - this causes fire to erupt on all adjacent tiles to Claire causing damage and setting enemy units and buildings on fire.
 Blink - Allows Claire to blink away - ignoring normal paths( so over buildings and other units ).
 Lightning storm - cast a lightning storm on a specific tile and all adjacent tiles


New Map - Bridges
I've also added a new map to the map pool called Bridges. This map has more of a base setup like starcraft so you move through the map trying to build near other 'bases' that have lumber, stone and gold.

Misc
Adding the lightning storm ability made it so I had to implement a way for tiles to have effects on them which is cool because it opens the doorway for me to add other effects to tiles quite easily. In the future, I can add things like random resources that you can pickup throughout the map by traversing a tile, taking damage by stepping on a tile or any other tile related effects.

Adding a new map is me trying to figure out the best way to take the game in terms of map design. I want their to be a reason to be out on the map but being out on the map will also give you increased vulnerability.

Until next time!
Jesse

notes.title: Sounds, Achievements, income building upgrades and tile resource improvements!
notes.content:
This update contains some changes to how income buildings work. I disliked the flow of just placing down a building and then having it automatically give you max resources from that tile. Now when you place a forester, stone quarry or gold mine.. you have the option to invest more resources into them so they can mine more for you. This creates a similar dynamic where you invest in workers in a game like starcraft. If you invest too much into workers, a small army could come destroy your city before you get the chance to build up your own army.

Updated tiles to have a limited amount of resources on them you can mine. You will have to move through the map to consume additional resources. This forces players to be active on the map. 

Added achievements to the game.

Added some sounds to certain things. This has a ways to go as far as getting sounds for every tiny little action but the sounds are great so far!

Discord Invite: https://discord.gg/WaUA7qv

Until next time!
-Jesse

notes.title: Version 0.3 - Upgrades, Upgrades, Upgrades!
notes.content:
The blacksmith is now a key strategic building going forward. Upgraded troops are much stronger than non-upgraded ones. They key here is to balance your resources between strategic upgrades and actually building units. Too few units and you will be overrun. One upgraded warrior still wont' beat two non-upgraded warriors but two upgraded warriors might beat three =).

Upgrades
Attack
This comes in three levels: I II and III. Each upgrade grants all of your units additional damage.

Defense
This comes in three levels: I II and III. Each upgrade grants all of your units additional armor.

Regeneration
This comes in three levels: I II and III. Each upgrade grants all of your units health at the beginning of your turn.

Resilience
This comes in three levels: I II and III. Each upgrade grants all of your units additional max HP.

Leather boots
This upgrade gives your knights one extra movement point per turn.

Advanced Fletching
Increases the range of your archers by one.

Advanced Awareness
Grants your units an additional range of vision. While the default distance a unit can see through the fog of war is one, with this upgrade they will be able to see two tiles.


Some minor beautification updates
UI
Started work towards a non-ugly UI. Added some HP bars where there used to be just numbers. Added various gradients to icons and backgrounds so things stopped looking so flat and plain.

Models
Added a builder model and animations to the builder unit. He can now idle, run, take damage, be killed and build a building. What a guy!

notes.title: Version 0.2 is here
notes.content:
In this update, I have added some different dynamics to the game that I feel are easier for a player to grasp from other games of a similar genre.

Builders
Before this update, you would select a building and build it within a radius of two from an Outpost or Keep. That's no longer a thing. You now use a builder that is spawned from a Keep. This builder can traverse the world like any other unit but can be transformed into a building. This is better because it allows you to colonize other parts of the map discreetly without having to expand your territory using outposts. Builders are also easily killed so there is a risk/reward dynamic inherent with this type of unit.

Menus
At the top level, there was a default menu that you could use to build buildings/units/ heros( soon ;) ), those are now gone. You build buildings from a menu associated with builders and you build units from a menu associated with the barracks and builders from a keep. I had gotten some negative feedback about clicking a tile like a barracks and not being able to train units. I agreed and this is a much cleaner experience.

Maps
Before I had two types of maps, a hexagon shape and a square shape. These would use a Perlin noise solution to generate all the resources values for a tile. This made the map cluttered and imbalanced. I took the time to create a map generator that I can use (and hopefully players in the future) to create maps so that randomness can be controlled.

Miscellaneous cleanup
With any update, lots of bugs are going to be fixed and unfortunately, some will be introduced. I will continue to make sure that these bugs are cleaned up as quickly as they appear :).



That's all for now. See you next time!

-Jesse
